summary: The candidate fixes the independently reproduced TorchDynamo import failure for cold and warm fullgraph traces, including a trace through the real is_dsa_enable_prefill_cp guard. It also preserves the ROCm pre-parallel-initialization short circuit identified during review of PR 628. Acceptance is recommended for the source-level fix, but the exact 8-GPU NVIDIA B200 MiniMax-M3 tc_piecewise serving deployment remains unqualified in this one-GPU ROCm environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Cold and warm minimal fullgraph traces and traces through the real DSA guard each reproduced Unsupported: Import failure; the real ROCm unpublished-parallel guard returned false without accessing parallel state.
Cold and warm fullgraph traces passed both directly and through is_dsa_enable_prefill_cp; the ROCm unpublished-parallel guard continued to return false without accessing parallel state.
Candidate regressions: 2 tests and 2 subtests passed.
Broader related candidate suites: 38 tests and 57 subtests passed.
On one AMD Instinct MI355X, cold and warm fullgraph GPU results matched an eager sin/cos reference with maximum absolute error 0.0.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X was visible through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; candidate-gpu-control.txt records cuda:0 execution and maximum absolute error 0.0 for cold and warm traces.

remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI355X was available; the reported 8 x NVIDIA B200 topology was unavailable.
MiniMax-M3 weights and the original tc_piecewise serving/capture workload were not available, so end-to-end server readiness and eight-rank capture remain unverified.
No MUSA hardware or torchada installation was available, so actual MUSA-device detection was checked by source semantics rather than hardware execution.
The candidate changes no native source, so no native rebuild was applicable.
